name: Kaddalakka
instructions: 1. Soak the black chickpeas overnight and pressure cook them with salt and turmeric until tender.
2. Heat coconut oil in a pan and add mustard seeds, letting them splutter.
3. Add dry red chilies and a generous amount of fresh curry leaves.
4. Stir in the freshly grated coconut and sauté until it turns slightly golden brown.
5. Add the cooked chickpeas to the pan, mixing well to combine with the coconut mixture.
6. Adjust salt if needed and serve hot as a nutritious snack or breakfast side.
description: Kaddalakka is a staple healthy dish in the islands of Lakshadweep. It reflects the local reliance on coconut and legumes, often prepared during local festivities or as a protein-rich daily breakfast, highlighting the simple yet flavorful culinary traditions of the archipelago.
